notes:
v1.0.81 - Share codes now REALLY work across launchers + universal modpack format:
1) SHARE CODES SERVER-BACKED: codes were stored only on the generating machine, so a code
   sent to a friend could never resolve. Now every code is published to the Reimagined share
   server (same backend as the CurseForge proxy) with 7-day expiry - it imports on ANY
   launcher. The generating device keeps a local mirror (instant + offline resolve). If the
   server is unreachable it falls back to a local-only code and says so.
2) UNIVERSAL MODPACK FORMAT (.mrpack): export is now a standard Modrinth .mrpack that the
   Modrinth App, Lunar Client, Prism and ATLauncher all import directly. The folder picker
   still lets you choose what travels (mods, resource packs, shaders, data packs, worlds
   pre-checked; config, game settings, screenshots, logs available) - everything ships under
   overrides/ so any launcher restores it offline.
3) IMPORT AUTO-DETECTS THE FORMAT: one Import button handles Modrinth .mrpack, CurseForge
   modpacks (manifest.json + overrides) and Reimagined exports - no format picker needed.
4) ZIPS ARE NOW COMPRESSED (DEFLATE): packages carrying worlds stay small instead of being
   stored raw. Export cap ~1GB with a clear message; import preview shows which folders the
   package carries.
5) SHARE MANIFEST v2: new folders field, whitelisted on import for safety.
